subject: Technical onramp: owner handoff and deliverable lanes for SDK + streaming
body:
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@medicorp.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Jessica Lin <jessica.lin@medicorp.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Technical onramp: owner handoff and deliverable lanes for SDK + streaming

Samir / Jessica — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed handoff so we have clear owners against the MAP milestone: "Integration build (SDK + streaming + tool-calls + structured outputs)". Please flag anything missing.

Key deliverables / owners (proposed):
- SDK integration (client libraries + examples): Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwood.com) — deliverable: SDK package and sample app. Target: internal PR by 2026-09-10.
- Streaming & token handling (continuous batches, reconnect logic): Vivek Kulkarni (vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com) — deliverable: streaming reference implementation and perf notes. Target: 2026-09-14.
- Tool-calling & structured outputs (function signatures, JSON schemas, validation): Neha Kapoor (neha_kapoor@redwood.com) — deliverable: schema repo and test harness. Target: 2026-09-12.
- End-to-end integration checklist + verification runbook: Aditya Rao (aditya_rao@redwood.com) — deliverable: checklist spreadsheet and test plan. Target: 2026-09-16.

Dependencies we noted:
1) Sandbox access for Medicorp devs (API keys + demo tenant) — Medicorp to provide by 2026-09-03.
2) Sample data set (anonymized) to validate structured outputs — Medicorp to confirm export format.
3) Contract signature for Dedicated trial (if applicable) to unlock higher concurrency quotas — procurement thread in parallel.

Next steps:
- Confirm owners above and target close date for this Milestone: proposed milestone close = 2026-09-20 (target move to MAP v0.4).
- Ben / Vivek / Neha / Aditya: confirm internal plan by EOD 2026-08-31.
- Samir / Jessica: confirm sandbox timeline and whether Medicorp will provide sample export or want Redwood to generate synthetic data.

Attachments: medicorp-map-v0.3.pdf (MAP draft), sdk-integration-checklist.xlsx (owner worksheet).

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

-----Original Message-----
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@medicorp.com>
Sent: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 15:24:00 -0700
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Jessica Lin <jessica.lin@medicorp.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Subject: Re: Technical onramp: owner handoff and deliverable lanes for SDK + streaming

Laura — this looks good, thanks for pulling it together. Two quick clarifications: 1) We need the streaming reference to include a reconnect pattern that preserves at-least-once ordering for our ingestion pipeline. 2) Can your SDK samples include both Python and Node? Our infra team is split.

On sandbox timing: Jessica is coordinating — we should be able to hand over API keys and a staging tenant by 2026-09-02, but I will confirm by EOD tomorrow. Regarding sample data, we can export a small anonymized payload in JSONL. Is that format acceptable?

Samir
Director, Platform Engineering | Medicorp

-----Original Message-----
From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Sent: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 16:03:00 -0700
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@medicorp.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Subject: Re: Technical onramp: owner handoff and deliverable lanes for SDK + streaming

Samir / team — confirmed: we will produce Python and Node samples. I can take the SDK scaffolding and put the sample app against the staging tenant once keys are live.
Ben
Engineering Manager, Integrations | Redwood

-----Original Message-----
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Sent: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 18:27:00 -0700
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@medicorp.com>, Jessica Lin <jessica.lin@medicorp.com>
Subject: Re: Technical onramp: owner handoff and deliverable lanes for SDK + streaming

Quick update from my side: I will add a small section to the streaming reference on "reconnect + ordering" patterns and include a perf note for expected token throughput for a 2x and 4x batch profile. Also, one dependency for us: can Medicorp enable websocket egress to *.redwood-inference.com from the staging subnet? If that's a blocker we can provide a short-lived ssh-tunnel alternative but it will change the verification checklist.

Vivek Kulkarni
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime | Redwood
